details.label: Fabric
details.value: 240 GSM 100% cotton, French terry / loopknit (supplier spec; we confirm it on the first samples)

details.label: Cut
details.value: Oversized, boxy, with a dropped shoulder

details.label: Fit
details.value: Unisex. Size by your usual size for the oversized look, or one down if you like it closer

details.label: Print
details.value: DTF. A small print on the front, the full graphic on the back

garment.printMethod: Every design is printed with DTF, short for direct-to-film. The artwork is printed onto a thin film first, then pressed into the cotton with heat. It lets us print sharp lines, small text and bright colours on dark fabric, which is most of what we do.

care.text: Turn it inside out before it goes in the machine.
Cold wash, 30°C or below, gentle cycle.
Mild detergent, no bleach, go easy on the fabric softener.
Dry it in the shade, or on low heat if you must use a dryer.
Never iron on the print. Iron it inside out, or put a sheet of baking paper over the design.

garment.careNote: Do all that and the print lasts. Skip it and it’s between you and your washing machine.
garment.colourNote: Colours on screens are approximate. The real tee and print may look slightly different depending on your display, the light, and small differences between fabric batches.
garment.shipping: Pre-order. At your door in 7–10 days. Free shipping across India. Cash on delivery available.
garment.returns: The full returns policy goes up before checkout opens. It'll be short and readable.

products.name: Face Card
products.blurb: A playing card for people who walk into a room and let their face do the talking. Face Card is a Y2K graphic t-shirt built around a king card, mirrored top and bottom the way real cards are, with the words “Face Card” across the middle. It’s the internet’s favourite compliment, printed where everyone behind you can read it. Wear it to the party, the wedding or the queue at the chai stall. The card does the rest.

products.name: Neo Bombay
products.blurb: Mumbai at night, if it were a video game. Neo Bombay is a retro graphic t-shirt with a full game screen on the back: a pink sunset, palm trees, a skyline, a sports car, a wanted level and a mission list that reads reach the airport, lose the tail, do not look back. A row of stars sits on the chest, three of them filled, so only the people who’ve played the game will get it. Press any key to continue.

products.name: Not Responding
products.blurb: For the days your brain has too many tabs open. Not Responding is a Y2K graphic t-shirt with a stack of old computer error windows on the back, the kind that appeared just before everything froze. It’s for Monday mornings, group projects and the fifth reminder about a deadline you already knew about. No restart required. You’ll come back online eventually, probably after lunch.

products.name: Atlas
products.blurb: Named after the Titan who held up the sky and never once skipped a day. Atlas is a gym graphic t-shirt for the ones who show up at six, load the bar and don’t post about it. It’s for leg day, back day and every day you thought about not going and went anyway. Wear it to the gym, or wear it to carry the group project. The weight is roughly the same.

products.name: Out of Office
products.blurb: Your auto-reply, but wearable. Out of Office is a travel graphic t-shirt with a luggage tag on the back, for the version of you that has stopped checking email. It’s made for beach towns, hill stations and any holiday where your phone stays in the bag. Leave the laptop at home. Leave the meetings to someone else. You’ll respond to all messages on your return, maybe.

products.name: The Overthinker
products.blurb: Card IX in a tarot deck is the Hermit, the one who goes quiet to think. We redrew it for the rest of us. The Overthinker is a tarot graphic t-shirt with a figure whose head is a tangle of scribbled thoughts, moons on either side and an open hand with an eye in the palm. It’s for 3 AM ceilings, unread replies and conversations you’re still replaying from last week. You’ve already thought about this enough. Wear it.
